subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw ship all five memory roles with per-agent overrides now, or initially expose only roles with complete invocation semantics?
rationale: The PR adds durable public plugin and config contracts, but recall and compaction have clearer execution ownership than capture, dreaming, and userModel; maintainers must choose whether to narrow the first API or complete every role before release.

options.title: Narrow the first contract
options.body: Ship only roles with defined selection and invocation semantics, then introduce additional roles alongside their protocols.

options.title: Complete all five roles
options.body: Keep the proposed surface and implement explicit global and per-agent invocation behavior plus proof for every role before merging.

options.title: Define activation-only roles
options.body: Document that some selectors only activate a plugin whose hooks self-enforce scope, accepting weaker exclusive-owner semantics.

recommendation.title: Narrow the first contract
recommendation.body: Ship only roles with defined selection and invocation semantics, then introduce additional roles alongside their protocols.

likelyOwner.reason: The original memory-slot design and major memory-plugin runtime refactors trace most strongly to this owner.
